pbcProvenance.evidence: Source CIF provides a crystallographic unit cell and fractional atomic coordinates; CIF crystal structures are 3D periodic.

libraryProvenance.name: COF-5
libraryProvenance.phase: COF-5：层间滑移 DFT 模型，沿 c 轴采用 2 倍重复。

source.name: Materials Cloud CURATED covalent organic frameworks database
source.citation: D. Ongari et al., Building a consistent and reproducible database for adsorption evaluation in Covalent-Organic Frameworks, Materials Cloud Archive 2021.100 (2021), DOI: 10.24435/materialscloud:z6-jn.
source.version: Materials Cloud Archive 2021.100, version v9 (June 2021 snapshot)
source.conditions: The source archive describes DFT-optimized coordinates and unit cell; its paper states that 05001N2 starts from the reported eclipsed COF-5 model, then relaxes to a lower-energy laterally shifted layer geometry (DOI: 10.1021/acscentsci.9b00619). The source curation note says the cell is replicated 2x in C; this pipeline adds no further repeat. Source CIF charge metadata remains raw-only.

normalization.method: pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser.from_str(check_cif=False, frac_tolerance=0, site_tolerance=0); parse_structures(primitive=False, check_occu=True, on_error='raise'); SpacegroupAnalyzer(symprec=0.01 Å, angle_tolerance=5.0°)
details: Materials Cloud v9 file 05001N2_ddec.cif selected from the archive in memory; no other database CIF was written.
CURATED-COFs source modification note retained verbatim: replicated 2x in C direction.

Raw CIF atom-site labels remain verbatim in source.cif. Parsed sites were uniquely matched to raw rows by element and periodic fractional-coordinate distance and reordered to that row order; sourceIndex is one-based and sourceAtomIds contains the corresponding normalized atoms.id values.

Source fractional coordinates converted to Cartesian Å; source cell vectors retained. Source atom-row ordering is restored only when a unique periodic-coordinate match is verified.
